LanguageData.WotF_MechWhispererSash.description: A woven cloth sash threaded with fine gold wire and set at the center with a miniature interface salvaged from an ancient ruin. It helps a mechanitor sustain more mech links and manage an additional control group, provided they already have a mechlink implant.
LanguageData.WotF_MechWhispererSash.label: mech-whisperer sash
